releases.zenodo_flat_vs_candidate_reconciliation: Independently re-verified 2026-09-12 (DuckDB EXCEPT, both directions, both configs): row counts, column names/order, dtypes, and every scientific/provenance value are identical between release/lafc-evict-v0.3-candidate and release/lafc-evict-v0.3-zenodo-flat. The packages differ ONLY in the row-level `release_version` tag column (candidate package correctly reads 'v0.3' on every row; zenodo-flat still reads the stale pre-finalization tag 'v0.3-candidate' on every row, never refreshed after the candidate package's final rebuild) and in Parquet row-group sizing (candidate: 112 row groups; zenodo-flat: 11 row groups; same codec/writer version), which explains the file-size difference. The previously recorded scientific_payload_hashes/total_bytes on this entry (now moved to the zenodo_flat_* fields above) actually belonged to the zenodo-flat package, not the candidate package named in canonical_local_source -- this has been corrected. release/lafc-evict-v0.3-candidate remains canonical for AWS/HF; the zenodo-flat package's release_version tag should be corrected before it is ever used to publish a Zenodo v0.3 version.
releases.zenodo_block_detail: Configured ZENODO_TOKEN authenticates (network reachable, public record reads succeed) but returns HTTP 403 Permission denied on GET /api/deposit/depositions and GET /api/deposit/depositions/21895844, tried with both query-param and Bearer-header auth. Token lacks deposit read/write scope, is expired, or belongs to an account without access to this record. Not remediated by this task per explicit stop-on-auth-failure instruction; a valid deposit-scoped production token is required before v0.3 can be created as a new Zenodo version under concept 21895843.
